plaatsen.tekst: And he said, Go. And he sent her away for two months: and she went with her companions, and bewailed her virginity upon the mountains.
She shall be brought unto the king in raiment of needlework: the virgins her companions that follow her shall be brought
And she said unto her father, Let this thing be done for me: let me alone two months, that I may go up and down upon the mountains, and bewail my virginity, I and my fellows.
